name: JoAi: List Products

description.en: List JoAi team catalog products (paginated) with names, prices, and visibility. Team members and agents with team access see the full manage catalog, including private and inactive rows, so obsolete duplicates can be found and deleted. Callers without team access still receive public, active products only.
description.de: JoAi Team-Produkte (paginiert) mit Namen, Preisen und Sichtbarkeit anzeigen. Team-Mitglieder und Agents mit Team-Zugriff sehen den gesamten Verwaltungskatalog, inklusive privater und inaktiver Einträge, damit veraltete Duplikate gefunden und gelöscht werden können. Ohne Team-Zugriff siehst du weiterhin nur öffentliche, aktive Produkte.

bot: Use this when the user wants to see their available products, materials, billable items, or manage the catalog including private and inactive rows. Results are paginated — use page/perPage and read meta.lastPage/meta.total for more, or pass search/category to narrow. Pass team as the team slug. Team members get the full catalog without extra flags; outsiders only see public active products. Category filter uses the first product tag; use __untagged__ for products without tags.

inputs.name: Page
inputs.bot: 1-based page number. Omit for the first page.

inputs.name: search
inputs.bot: Optional name search. Prefer this over paging through large catalogs when looking for one product.

inputs.name: category

description.en: Filter by category (first product tag), or __untagged__

inputs.bot: Optional. First tag is the category. Use __untagged__ for products without tags. Category options come from GET /v1/products/categories.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug to list products for. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug, für das Produkte angezeigt werden. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team whose products to list. Omit to use the current team.
